testimonies.name: Maria G.
testimonies.text: Receiving this Bible changed everything for me. I never expected someone to reach out with such a personal gift. It felt like a hug from God. I have been reading it every morning since the day I received it.

testimonies.name: James T.
testimonies.text: I had so many questions about faith and wasn't sure where to start. This ministry gave me not just a Bible but a community that walked alongside me with patience and love. I am forever grateful.

testimonies.name: Priya N.
testimonies.text: The personalized note inside my Bible still makes me smile every time I open it. Someone prayed for me specifically — a stranger. That changed how I see God's love for me personally.
